verses.text: Ayxotax yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Abram icha tik: Aktejkan a lum tik yet' jantak heb' ay uj a b'a yet'ok yet' heb' ayek' t'a spat a mam, ol ach b'at t'a jun lu'um ol in ch'ox t'ayach.
Ha inhtilal ol och niwak nacional wu'uj, ol in ch'oxan in wach'k'olal t'ayach. Yelxo wal niwan ol aj a b'inaji, u'uj ol scha wach'k'olal masanil heb' anima.

Ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a heb' wach' syutej sb'a t'ayach, ol in katab'ejpax heb' chuk syutej sb'a. U'ujnhej ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix el winhaj Abram t'a yol yik Harán chi', icha ajnak yalankan Jehová t'a winh. 75 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix el winh t'a yol yik Harán chi'. Ix yik'ankot ix yetb'eyum winh yet'ok, haton ix Sarai. Ix yik'paxkot winhaj Lot winh, haton winh yunin winh yuk'tak winh chamnak. Ix yik'paxkot heb' schekab' winh yet' jantak tas ix aj t'a winh ayik ix ek' winh t'a Harán chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sja winh t'a yol yik Canaán.
Ix kotnhej winh t'a yol yik Canaán chi' masanto ix jawi winh t'a Siquem b'aj ay jun te' ji t'a yol yik More. Ha jun te' chi' chajul yuj heb' cananeo kajan ta'.

Hata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová t'a winhaj Abram chi', ix yalan t'a winh icha tik: Masanil jun lu'um tik ol wak' t'a heb' inhtilal, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix sb'o jun altar winhaj Abram chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto hata' ix sch'ox sb'a t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a tzalkixtak t'a snanhal chonhab' Betel yet' chonhab' Hai. Hata' ix sb'ok'e smantiado winh. Ha chonhab' Betel chi', ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u ay. Hata' ix sb'o junxo altar winh yik syal sb'a winh t'a Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi' k'ojank'olal ix kotxi winh masanto ix jawi winh t'a yol yik Neguev.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix ja jun niwan wejel t'a jun lugar b'aj ayek' winhaj Abram chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at kajan winh jun pekti' t'a Egipto.
Ayik wan sk'och winh t'a Egipto chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix yetb'eyum chi' haton ix Sarai: Ha tikne'ik ay jun tas tzin na'a: Ha ach tik te wach' ilji.
Yuj chi' ayik ol ach yilan heb' winh aj Egipto tik, ol am yal heb' winh icha tik: Ha ix tik yetb'eyum ton wal winh tik ix, yuj chi' ko milekcham winh yik skan ix ket'ok, xcham heb' winh.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayach to wanab' ach halani, yik wach' xajan ol in aj yuj heb' winh, manh ol in smilcham heb' winh u'uj, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ayik ix k'och winh t'a Egipto chi', ix yilanoch heb' winh kajan ta' to a ix Sarai chi' te wach' yilji ix.
Ix yilanpax heb' ay yopisio yet' winh rey to te wach' yilji ix, ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winh rey chi'. Yuj chi' ix yik'anb'at ix heb' winh t'a spat winh rey chi'.

Yuj ix Sarai chi', te xajan ix aj winhaj Abram yuj winh rey chi'. Tzijtum nok' kalnel, nok' wakax, nok' mam b'uru yet' nok' snun yet' nok' camello ix siaj t'a winh yuj winh rey chi'. Ay pax heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix, ix ak'ji schekab'ok winh.
Palta yujnhej ix, tzijtum yahelal ix jawi t'a yib'anh winh rey yet' heb' kajan yet' winh t'a spat yuj Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix schek winh rey chi' awtajkot winhaj Abram chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: ¿Tas yuj icha tik tzin utej? ¿Tas yuj maj al t'ayin tato etb'eyum ix tik?
Ina ix ala' to anab' ix, yuj chi' ix in na to tz'och ix wetb'eyumok. Ha tikne'ik jun, ik'b'at ix, ixikek, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' schekab' to tz'ik'jiel winhaj Abram t'a yol smakb'en Egipto chi' yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' masanil tas ay t'a winh.
